The same 21 homes as the PDF you have, Hicksville to Ronkonkoma, now in a form you can answer from your phone: cheapest first, a map, and a button on every home. The eight from your first packet are marked ★ with their old number.

Keep it like an app: tap Share in Safari, then Add to Home Screen. Your answers are saved on this phone until you send them.

  1. Tap Like, Pass or Question on each home. Like at least five so we can plan a full day.
  2. Plan your showing day at the bottom: one or two days and a time window.
  3. Tap Send to Chris. He texts you back to confirm the showings and sends your itinerary.
